findings.label: help.rs over the 400-line limit
findings.detail: crates/ff-desktop/src/shell/help.rs is ~499 non-test lines (was 462 before this change); rust-standards requires splitting a source file before growing it past 400 non-test lines. Behaviour is correct and the coder self-reported a behaviour-preserving split as separate follow-up refactor work. Non-blocking.
